⚠️ Hardware Compatibility Notice:

• Dual-Path Devices (Dedicated Bypass IC / ROG Phone, Infinix Bypass, Black Shark, Sony): Equipped with a physical hardware switch routing charger power directly to the motherboard without charging the battery (0 mA, zero battery drain).

• Single-Path Devices (Redmi Note 7, Xiaomi/POCO standard, & most phones): Use a unified PMIC line without a dedicated bypass switch.
- When actively used (screen ON / gaming / high load), system consumption (350–700mA) exceeds the restricted charger current. The battery will continue draining (tekor), dropping in percentage, and triggering continuous on/off flapping cycles.

💡 Recommendations for Single-Path Devices:
• Overnight Charging: Set slider to 100% (AutoCut) so charging terminates naturally and safely while sleeping.
• Gaming While Plugged In: Use Cool Charging Mode (~1200–1500mA) in the Fast Charging tab to maintain low thermals without battery drain.

Do you understand this hardware behavior and wish to proceed?

Motherboard Bypass forces charging to stop and routes power directly to phone hardware.

⚠️ Single-Path Hardware Notice:
Devices without a dedicated physical bypass IC (such as Redmi Note 7) cannot isolate power rails. Enabling bypass will completely cut off adapter input, causing the device to run solely on battery power (Discharging).
